verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Authenticator can hold and use a passkey for phishing-resistant sign-in (docs-23). Nothing in the pack documents those passkeys syncing across iOS, Android, Windows, Linux or browsers. The cloud and iCloud backup docs cover restoring accounts to a new phone, not cross-ecosystem passkey sync, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
